info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Careers Applications Jobs-v5-spec
info.description: The Job Applications Listing API allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of job applications available within the careers section. This endpoint enables companies and recruiters to manage and track job application postings efficiently. Typical consumers of this API include human resources personnel and recruitment platforms looking to enhance their job listing capabilities. By providing real-time access to job application data, users can streamline their hiring processes and improve candidate engagement.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of job applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all job applications currently available. You can use filtering and pagination parameters to refine your results.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve job applications. It should contain all necessary filters and parameters required for querying specific job listings.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of jobs.

ListCareersApplicationsJobsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on applications jobs.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the application reference.

resultId.description: The ID of the result generated by the operation.

state.description: Current state of the application process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the application in milliseconds.

message.description: A descriptive message about the operation result.

audit.description: Information related to the auditing of the operation.

ListCareersApplicationsJobsResponse_200.description: Response schema for the GET operation on applications and jobs.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the application.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the application was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the application was processed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing audit information for the operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This value helps to understand the performance of the API call.
